claims: For the car branch, static rest sizing composes tire basis=(2*widthTable[TireWidth], ratio,ratio) and rim basis=(2*widthTable[TireWidth],ratio*profileDiameter,ratio*profileDiameter), with ratio=table669a10[RimSize-12]/profileDiameter. This claim excludes camber, runtime deformation and wheel placement.

For bikes, initialization captures twice each rest wheel global Y translation as the Y/Z local joint scale. Static tire scale is (0.89*4*wheel joint constraint transmaxX,2*restY,2*restY); rim has the same X and additionally multiplies Y/Z by0.85 if native classenum5 (chopper),otherwise0.7. It excludes runtime wheelrotation,camber,deformation.
